name: How do you choose a builder for a fourplex project?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for a fourplex in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for a fourplex in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fourplex is not the kind of project where general residential experience alone is enough. Searchers usually need a practical checklist: multifamily experience, local city familiarity, budget transparency, trade coordination, and the ability to manage inspections and corrections. They also want to know how to compare bids that may not be apples-to-apples. A good answer should warn that the cheapest bid is often the least useful if it excludes site work, utility coordination, or allowance realism. The page should also encourage owners to review recent similar projects and confirm that the builder understands the city-specific approval path. That makes the content more actionable than a generic contractor-hiring article.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder with multifamily experience, local permit familiarity, strong scheduling practices, and a proven record of coordinating architectural and engineering details. Fourplex construction is more complex than a standard single-family remodel.
